problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate a fixed budget across 19 different infrastructure projects to maximize the total expected community benefit.
The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: expected benefit is 0.033, disruption index is 0.096, allocation bounds [0.006, 0.869]
* Project B: expected benefit is 0.053, disruption index is 0.044, allocation bounds [0.070, 0.843]
* Project C: expected benefit is 0.151, disruption index is 0.077, allocation bounds [0.011, 0.722]
* Project D: expected benefit is 0.184, disruption index is 0.184, allocation bounds [0.047, 0.759]
* Project E: expected benefit is 0.136, disruption index is 0.106, allocation bounds [0.092, 0.321]
* Project F: expected benefit is 0.109, disruption index is 0.075, allocation bounds [0.026, 0.889]
* Project G: expected benefit is 0.170, disruption index is 0.283, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.870]
* Project H: expected benefit is 0.123, disruption index is 0.277, allocation bounds [0.034, 0.659]
* Project I: expected benefit is 0.105, disruption index is 0.083, allocation bounds [0.026, 0.667]
* Project J: expected benefit is 0.083, disruption index is 0.214, allocation bounds [0.033, 0.348]
* Project K: expected benefit is 0.131, disruption index is 0.030, allocation bounds [0.076, 0.631]
* Project L: expected benefit is 0.121, disruption index is 0.263, allocation bounds [0.014, 0.868]
* Project M: expected benefit is 0.045, disruption index is 0.291, allocation bounds [0.055, 0.462]
* Project N: expected benefit is 0.032, disruption index is 0.032, allocation bounds [0.073, 0.325]
* Project O: expected benefit is 0.097, disruption index is 0.177, allocation bounds [0.092, 0.321]
* Project P: expected benefit is 0.088, disruption index is 0.257, allocation bounds [0.066, 0.605]
* Project Q: expected benefit is 0.033, disruption index is 0.280, allocation bounds [0.088, 0.690]
* Project R: expected benefit is 0.034, disruption index is 0.155, allocation bounds [0.024, 0.559]
* Project S: expected benefit is 0.161, disruption index is 0.126, allocation bounds [0.007, 0.482]
Each project must receive a budget share that falls within its specified bounds, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total available budget. To ensure timely completion, the group of high-priority projects, represented by the subset H = {A, B, D, G, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, S}, must collectively receive at least 0.544 of the total budget. Furthermore, the overall disruption index for the portfolio must not exceed 0.216, and the total expected benefit must be at least 0.078. Please determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total expected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
